goal: Read docs/IDEA.md with no history and write docs/BRIEF.md: what this round asks for.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/BRIEF.md has the sections Asked, Deliverable, Done when, Unclear and Not asked
It restates only what docs/IDEA.md says

decisions.what: Scoped the brief to three changes: the Start-DataBoot.ps1 Python-detection and error-handling fix, AC-25 per-sheet isolation logging for corrupt sheets, and one test that the launcher has no hardcoded single Python version
decisions.why: These are the only items the idea lists, and it says to change only what these suggestions ask
decisions.evidence: docs/IDEA.md line 8: "change only what these suggestions ask"

decisions.what: Listed Python 3.14 and versions older than 3.11 under Not asked
decisions.why: The idea limits the search to 3.11-3.13 even though 3.14 is installed on the Board's machine
decisions.evidence: docs/IDEA.md line 4: "pick the newest installed Python 3.11-3.13"

decisions.what: Treated the failure handling as: print a clear message, delete the partial .venv, pause, exit 1
decisions.why: The idea spells out this exact sequence for a failed native command
decisions.evidence: docs/IDEA.md line 4: "print a clear message, delete the partial .venv, pause so the window stays open, exit 1"

tried_and_failed: Running python3 /opt/prodagents/check.py brief was blocked by the zero-context hook, so the brief is unchecked
